Job Summary The Clinical Operations Department is Whitman-Walker Health's centralized medical, dental, and behavioral health support departmen t. The Client Services Front Desk Manager (CSFM) provides day-to-day leadership and operational oversight of Client Services Representatives (CSRs) and front desk o perations across all Whitman-Walker Health locations. This is an on-site, non-remote management position requiring regular in-person collaboration with staff, patients, providers, and interdisciplinary teams in a fast-paced clinical environment. Reporting to the Client Services Manager, the Client Services Front Desk Manager oversees front-end administrative operations to ensure efficient patient access, exceptional customer service, regulatory compliance, and adherence to organizational and departmental standards. The position is responsible for managing patient registration, appointment scheduling for medical and behavioral health services, insurance verification and Real-Time Eligibility (RTE), benefits validation, referrals, payment collection, patient cost estimates, demographic and insurance updates, interpreter coordination, and other patient access and revenue cycle functions. The Client Services Front Desk Manager partners closely with clinical leaders, the Call Center, Revenue Cycle, and other operational departments to optimize workflows, monitor quality and productivity metrics, develop and coach staff, implement process improvements, and foster a patient-centered environment that reflects Whitman-Walker Health's mission, values, and commitment. Ensures payroll deadlines are met and required timekeeping corrections are completed in a timely manner . Oversees and monitors assigned work queues ( e.g. appt requests, referrals) to ensure timely processing and follow-up. Ensures staff have appropriate supplies, equipment, and operational resources necessary to perform their duties effectively. Ensures public-facing areas remain clean, organized, and professional. Supports processing of incoming mail. Communication: Direct and indirect communication. Written and verbal competence. Two (2) years of experience in a lead, supervisory, or other staff oversight capacity, including experience providing coaching, training, performance feedback, workflow guidance, and day-to-day operational support. 2 years of experience working with a broadly diverse population and ability to work harmoniously with diverse groups of individuals required. 2 years of experience working with members of the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender Gender Expansive, Queer, Asexual, Intersexed communities preferred. 2 years of experience working with people living with HIV or issues related to HIV care preferred. The position requires frequent interaction with patients, staff, providers, and other departments and may require periods of standing, walking, and working at a front desk or workstation. May be required to report to work or support operations during inclement weather and other emergency or operational events in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. Physical Demands: Lifting: No more than 20 lbs. and infrequently. Movement: Requires prolonged periods of sitting and standing, with frequent movement throughout the work area to support staff and front desk operations. Visual: Long periods on computer . Concentration: Requires sustained attention to detail and concentration when using computer systems and entering, reviewing, and verifying patient, scheduling, insurance, financial, and other operational information. Requires intermittent use of telephone and communication systems to respond to patient, staff, and departmental inquiries while maintaining accuracy and professionalism. It is not to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities required. As the nature of our business demands changes, so too may the duties and responsibilities of this position. You may be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned .
